title: A put and the header it answers with
note: There is no body beyond the header: a put tells you when it happened, not what it wrote. Ask for `prev_kv` when you want the value that was there before.

title: Reading the write back
note: create_revision is set once and never moves; mod_revision follows every put; version counts the puts since the key was created, so it is 1 after the first.
